result.requirement: The system shall continuously recalculate optimal delivery paths for Delivery Partners by integrating live traffic data and new Order Request insertions.
result.business_need: The business needs to minimize delivery times and fuel costs while ensuring timely order fulfillment in a dynamic logistics environment.
functional_behaviour: The system shall ingest real-time traffic updates and new Order Requests to trigger immediate route re-optimization.
The system shall reassign Delivery Assignment tasks to the most suitable Delivery Partner based on current proximity and capacity.
The system shall update the estimated arrival time and travel distance for all affected Fulfillment Tasks.
The system shall notify the Delivery Partner of the revised route and new delivery slot via the mobile interface.
The system shall maintain a Real-Time Inventory Snapshot to ensure assigned routes only include orderable items.
related_information_requirements: Live traffic patterns and road constraints
Current location and speed of active Delivery Partners
Real-time status of Order Requests (pending, ready, dispatched)
Customer delivery address and contact details
Aggregate fleet capacity within the service zone
business_rules: A route must be recalculated whenever a new Order Request is inserted into an active zone.
Route optimization must prioritize the earliest Estimated Arrival Time for high-priority orders.
A Delivery Partner cannot be assigned a new task if their current workload exceeds the defined capacity threshold.
Reassigned routes must be communicated to the Delivery Partner within the maximum allowable notification latency.

acceptance_criteria.given: A new Order Request is inserted into a zone with active Delivery Partners
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the new request against live traffic data
acceptance_criteria.then: The system recalculates the optimal route and updates the Assigned Delivery Slot for the affected Delivery Partner within the defined latency window

acceptance_criteria.given: Live traffic data indicates a major road closure on the current optimal path
acceptance_criteria.when: The system detects the traffic anomaly during route calculation
acceptance_criteria.then: The system generates an alternative route that avoids the closure and notifies the Delivery Partner of the change
